<message t="09:07" d="22.02" type="text">def chord_to_df(chords, times=None):
    freq_map={'C':261.63,'Dm':293.66,'G':392}
    rows=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(chords):
        start=times[i] if times else i
        end=start+1
        rows.append([c,freq_map.get(c,0),start,end])
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['chord','freq','start','end'])</message>

<message t="19:15" d="15.02" type="text">nested while? just put another while inside the block. make sure the inner loop updates its own condition, else you’ll get an infinite loop. example:  
```
i=0
while i<5:
    j=0
    while j<3:
        print(i,j)
        j+=1
    i+=1
```  
</message>
